issue: "bekommen (bekommt, bekam, hat bekommen)": auxiliary "hat", Wiktionary has haben or sein
why: bekommen in its usual sense (to get, to receive) always takes haben; sein is only for the rare sense 'to agree with' (Das Essen ist mir gut bekommen).

issue: "stehen (steht, stand, hat gestanden) (+ D)": auxiliary "hat", Wiktionary has haben or sein
why: Standard German (Duden) uses haben; ist gestanden is southern German, Austrian and Swiss. The course teaches the standard form.

issue: "die Bank, -en": plural Banken, Wiktionary has Bänke
why: Homograph: die Bank (financial institution) has the plural Banken; Bänke is the plural of die Bank meaning bench, which is the entry the lexicon picks first.
